title: Basis and gain or loss — five transactions
instructions: Compute basis and gain or loss for each transaction (individual taxpayers).

exhibits.title: Transactions
exhibits.content:
A. Stock received as a gift: donor's basis **$30,000**, FMV at gift **$22,000**. The donee sells it for **$25,000**.
B. The same gifted stock is instead sold for **$18,000**.
C. Stock inherited: decedent's basis **$10,000**, FMV at death **$50,000**. Sold 3 months after death for **$55,000**.
D. 100 shares (basis **$8,000**) are sold for **$6,000**; 100 identical shares are bought 2 weeks later for **$6,500**.
E. Land bought for **$100,000** cash plus assumption of the seller's **$300,000** mortgage.

parts.prompt: Compute the following (enter losses as positive amounts).

rows.label: A: recognized gain or loss
rows.explanation: Gain basis 30,000 and loss basis 22,000 bracket the 25,000 price: **no gain or loss**.

rows.label: B: recognized loss
rows.explanation: Loss basis is the lower FMV: 22,000 − 18,000 = **4,000**.

rows.label: D: basis of the new shares
C: inherited stock sold 3 months after death
B: gifted stock sold at a loss 4 months after the gift, using FMV basis
rows.explanation: With FMV basis, the holding period starts at the gift date.
